name: Squad player Count Sound(with Cooldown)
author: Dan2023 - https://people.mozilla.org/p/dan2023
description: Play a short sound by user 'nachosose' hosted on https://pixabay.com when the player-count is above a custom set value on any 'Squad' server that is opened in Firefox, with a 30-minute cooldown. Complies with Pixabay license at https://pixabay.com/service/license-summary/ . Requires Fx 128.0 or newer. Included 'content-script.js' created with GREAT support from free GPT-3.5 @ https://www.perplexity.ai - How to use: after installation, open any Squad server page starting with https://www.battlemetrics.com/servers/squad/* and set the pages' Autoplay permission to 'Allow Audio and Video'.
